title: docs(verify): posture-only docblocks say what the stand-in walls and what it does not
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"marchtian"} -->
_Requested by **田騏** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01VmuUhXU9SSUzqJYyXSmYSi?thread=cmsg_01VmuUhXU9SSUzqJYyXSmYSi9paTx1Lu8ENYwwssthfK3h)_

Fixes #28703

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：只改 `packages/verify/src/harness.ts` 里的注释（`SimulatedOrgScopingPlugin`、`BootOptions.multiTenant: 'posture-only'`、`orgContext` 一段、一行行内注释），外加一条 `@objectstack/verify` patch changeset；不改任何代码。
- 为什么改：旧注释说 posture-only 启动"不打 organization_id、不做隔离，跨组织测试写了也白写"；ADR-0131 之后引擎按姿态落组织、Layer 0 按姿态拦截，注释与代码正相反，会让写测试的人放弃本可低成本钉住的跨组织隔离。
- 风险与回滚：零运行时风险（仅注释，`dist/index.d.ts` 里的 JSDoc 随之变化）；回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- 先看：`packages/verify/src/harness.ts` 的 `multiTenant` 文档块（"What it walls" / "What it does NOT give a fixture" 两节）；其次文件顶部 `SimulatedOrgScopingPlugin` 文档块。
- 两分钟验证：`git diff origin/main...HEAD -- packages/verify/src/harness.ts`，预期只见注释行变动、无一行代码变化。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地。

## What changes

Comments only, in `packages/verify/src/harness.ts`, plus a `patch` changeset for `@objectstack/verify` (the `BootOptions` JSDoc ships in `dist/index.d.ts`, so the published bytes change).

- **`SimulatedOrgScopingPlugin` docblock.** The "⛔ It stamps no `organization_id` and scopes no query" sentence is replaced. The stand-in itself still stamps and scopes nothing, but since ADR-0131 (D8, D11) the wall is open-core code that keys on the posture the stand-in makes true. The engine lands an insert in the caller's active organization (`ObjectQL#driverWriteTarget`), the SQL driver fills an absent `organization_id` (`SqlDriver#injectTenantOnInsert`), and reads are scoped by the one Layer 0 verdict (`computeTenantLayer0Verdict`, `postureEnforcesWall`).
- **`BootOptions.multiTenant` `'posture-only'` section.** "It performs no tenant isolation whatsoever … would assert nothing and pass" is removed. Two subsections replace it:
  - *What it walls*: insert and read, with the code locations behind each.
  - *What it does NOT give a fixture*: no default-organization bootstrap (the admin resolves org-less), no per-organization seed replay, no walled membership-policy gate, no deployment declarations on the service, and the memory driver refuses a walled posture.
  The section tells a cross-organization fixture to measure the wall, and points to the precondition case of `packages/qa/dogfood/test/create-caller-id-collision-walled.dogfood.test.ts` as the shape.
- **`orgContext` docblock.** "Cross-tenant isolation has exactly one honest proof in this repo: `multiTenant: true`" is replaced. A cross-tenant fixture needs a walled posture, either `'posture-only'` or `true`. The "asserts nothing on `single`" sentence stays, because it is still true. It now names the Layer 0 verdict as well as the RLS strip.
- **Inline comment** at the `'posture-only'` branch of `bootStack`: "activates the POSTURE, never the WALL" now says the open core's wall follows from the posture.

## Tests

No behaviour changes, so no test was added or changed.

<details><summary>Local runs at head 5b630f038e</summary>

- `pnpm --filter '@objectstack/verify...' build` (under `os-verify-lock`): `VERDICT command-exit 0`.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/verify typecheck`: `VERDICT command-exit 0`. `check:test-typecheck: OK`.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/verify exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2`: `Test Files 48 passed (48)`, `Tests 401 passed (401)`, `VERDICT command-exit 0`.
- Published-surface check after the build: `dist/index.d.ts` contains "What it does NOT give a fixture" (1 match) and "performs no tenant isolation whatsoever" (0 matches). The positive control `databaseDriver` has 2 matches. `files` is `["dist","README.md","CHANGELOG.md"]`.

</details>

## Acceptance notes

- **Changeset level.** os-dev's fast track lists comments as not published. Here, though, the `BootOptions` JSDoc measurably ships in `dist/index.d.ts`, so this takes a `patch` changeset, not `skip-changeset`.
- **Left as is (out of scope).** The `SimulatedOrgScopingPlugin` docblock still says "The proof that the REAL plugin walls tenants lives in cloud's `security-enterprise` multi-org integration test". The read wall is now open-core code that this repo pins too (see the walled pin above), so that sentence understates where the proof lives. It is not a defect, and this PR does not touch it.
- **Spec docblock (not edited, out of scope).** `postureStampsOrganization`'s docblock in `packages/spec/src/security/tenancy-posture.ts` says the stamper is the enterprise runtime, "not the open engine". The open engine plus the SQL driver now stamp the active organization on insert in every posture (`ObjectQL#driverWriteTarget`, `SqlDriver#injectTenantOnInsert`). This looks like the same class of drift in another package. It is noted here and not filed.
